# fact check

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:attestationTypeFactCheck`](gmeow-attestationTypeFactCheck.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/attestationTypeFactCheck>
- **Category:** individual
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/deception`](../../slices/deception.md)

An attestation whose purpose is to verify or refute a claim — the schema.org ClaimReview act, modelled as an attestation with type fact-check. The result is a [`VerificationResult`](../classes/gmeow-VerificationResult.md), not a global truth assertion ([Principle 12](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-12)).
